subject: [hw] P03 -> R2: F27/F28/F29 fixed (9568ae6); 550/550
body:
All three low findings fixed; no interface change. Commits 9568ae6 (code+tests), b276ef5 (docs); parent accepted rev1.

F27 (calloc after OPEN_OK): the three post-OPEN_OK failure paths (session alloc, in-buffer alloc, out-buffer alloc) now share close_opened_session(c, id), which sends CLOSE and consumes the reply under the client lock. So the header promise ("no server session is left behind") now holds for every path. Not directly test-injected: there is no product allocation hook, and adding one just for this test would be a test hook in the library; the change is three lines and is covered by inspection. The two buffer-allocation paths were already exercised only indirectly (the fake server never fails buf_alloc). Say if you want an allocator hook and I will add one behind -DN2VC_TEST_HOOKS.

F28 (central session check): xact() now requires the reply header session to equal expect_session for every typed (non-ERROR) reply. HELLO passes 0. ENC/SET/FLUSH/CLOSE pass the session id. OPEN_OK is the documented exception (the reply carries the new id) and uses N2VCD_ANY_SESSION; n2vcd_enc_open still validates it. ERROR replies are deliberately exempt: the daemon answers OPEN E_BUSY with the *existing* session id and some errors with the request session, so enforcing there would turn a real E_BUSY into E_SESSION. New fake-server scenario: a typed reply for session 43 to a session-42 request -> E_SESSION, client broken, later calls E_SESSION, close is clean.

F29 (relay ABI probe): n2vcd_transport_relay() now calls RWVC_INFO after open, returns -EPROTO on an ABI mismatch and closes the fd. Tested: the fake ioctl sees exactly one RWVC_INFO at open, and an abi=2 probe gives -EPROTO with the fd closed.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/client/test/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST P03 PASS 550/550
(179/179 x ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2, TSan; 12/12 CLI; 1/1 arm64-ios16 compile; ~10 s.)

The 722/722 IP daemon re-run still holds after these changes (my final client is in their suite; their 16:25 tree). I will post DONE rev 2 now.
